reasoning_steps: Identified new amino acids and their therapeutic uses or roles mentioned in the text.
Classified these new amino acids based on their chemical structure or metabolic fate, and anchored them to bfo:MaterialEntity.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Glycine is an AminoAcid that is used to treat schizophrenia, sleep issues, BPH, metabolic syndrome, and inherited metabolic illnesses.
classes.comment: Glycine is an amino acid used in medicine for various conditions.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An Alanine is an AminoAcid that is utilized to boost immunity and provide the brain and central nervous system more energy.
classes.comment: Alanine is an amino acid that supports immunity and brain energy.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Valine is an AminoAcid that is involved in muscle synthesis and maintenance, stress management, child growth, and immune system support.
classes.comment: Valine is a branched-chain amino acid important for muscle and immunity.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Leucine is an AminoAcid that increases physical performance, prevents muscle loss, and lowers blood glucose levels in type 2 diabetes.
classes.comment: Leucine is a branched-chain amino acid that enhances physical performance and regulates blood sugar.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An Isoleucine is an AminoAcid that is required for children's optimum growth and the maintenance of nitrogen balance in adults.
classes.comment: Isoleucine is a branched-chain amino acid crucial for growth and nitrogen balance.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Norleucine is an AminoAcid that is an artificial amino acid used to research protein structure and function.
classes.comment: Norleucine is a synthetic amino acid used in laboratory research.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Phenylalanine is an AminoAcid that is used to treat depression, Parkinson's illness, multiple sclerosis, pain, acupuncture anesthesia, and osteoarthritis.
classes.comment: Phenylalanine is an aromatic amino acid used in treating neurological and pain conditions.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Tyrosine is an AminoAcid that is utilized in the production of thyroid hormone and helps with mental performance, alertness, and memory.
classes.comment: Tyrosine is an aromatic amino acid involved in thyroid hormone production and cognitive function.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Serine is an AminoAcid that is particularly significant for the brain and central nervous system to function correctly.
classes.comment: Serine is an amino acid essential for proper brain and central nervous system function.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Cysteine is an AminoAcid that is used in medicine to boost the efficiency of corticosteroid medications.
classes.comment: Cysteine is a sulfur-containing amino acid that enhances corticosteroid efficacy.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Cystine is an AminoAcid that can be used in the treatment of surgery and trauma.
classes.comment: Cystine is a sulfur-containing amino acid used in post-surgical and trauma treatment.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Threonine is an AminoAcid that is used to treat spinal spasticity, multiple sclerosis, familial spastic paraparesis, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
classes.comment: Threonine is an amino acid used in treating neurological conditions like spasticity and sclerosis.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Methionine is an AminoAcid that is used to prevent and cure depression, inflammation, liver illness, and muscle discomfort.
classes.comment: Methionine is a sulfur-containing amino acid used for depression, inflammation, and liver health.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Tryptophan is an AminoAcid that has been used to treat anxiety and depression, and is used to treat migraines, headaches, and boost growth hormone production.
classes.comment: Tryptophan is an amino acid used for mood disorders, migraines, and growth hormone stimulation.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Proline is an AminoAcid that is used to improve joint and skin health, and may help with muscle development and injury healing.
classes.comment: Proline is an imino acid beneficial for joint, skin, and muscle health.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Hydroxyproline is an AminoAcid that is required for the formation of collagen, the body's principal structural protein.
classes.comment: Hydroxyproline is an imino acid essential for collagen formation and structural integrity.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An AsparticAcid is an AminoAcid that is occasionally used to treat stress and exhaustion, and aids in energy generation and RNA/DNA manufacturing.
classes.comment: Aspartic Acid is an acidic amino acid involved in energy production and nucleic acid synthesis.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An Asparagine is an AminoAcid that is necessary for brain development and function.
classes.comment: Asparagine is an amide amino acid crucial for brain development and function.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A GlutamicAcid is an AminoAcid that serves as a source of energy for the brain, improves brain clarity, mental alertness, and mood, and is used to treat Parkinson's, Fatigue, and Schizophrenia.
classes.comment: Glutamic Acid is an acidic amino acid vital for brain energy, cognition, and mood, used in treating neurological disorders.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A BetaHydroxyGlutamicAcid is an AminoAcid that is used to treat acne, photoaging, dry skin, psoriasis, and melasma, and has been studied for fibromyalgia, dental scaling, dry mouth, and urinary tract stones.
classes.comment: Beta-Hydroxy Glutamic Acid is an amino acid used for dermatological conditions and studied for other health issues.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Glutamine is an AminoAcid that is used to keep blood sugar levels under control and consistent.
classes.comment: Glutamine is an amide amino acid that helps regulate blood sugar levels.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An Ornithine is an AminoAcid that is primarily used in health supplements to support sports and performance, and to help with liver function and wound healing.
classes.comment: Ornithine is an amino acid used for sports performance, liver function, and wound healing.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An Arginine is an AminoAcid that plays an important role in the treatment of cardiovascular disease due to its antiatherogenic, anti-ischemic, antiplatelet, and antithrombotic effects.
classes.comment: Arginine is a basic amino acid beneficial for cardiovascular health.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Lysine is an AminoAcid that appears to minimize cold sores when taken orally or applied topically.
classes.comment: Lysine is an amino acid used to manage cold sores.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Histidine is an AminoAcid that is used to treat anemia and can reduce blood pressure, and is critical in baby feeding.
classes.comment: Histidine is a basic amino acid important for hemoglobin, blood pressure, and infant nutrition.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A D-Penicillamine is a NonStandardAminoAcid that is a metabolite of penicillin and is employed in the chelation therapy of Wilson’s disease.
classes.comment: D-Penicillamine is a non-standard amino acid used for Wilson's disease treatment.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A N-Acetylcysteine is a NonStandardAminoAcid that is used in cystic fibrosis and chronic renal insufficiency as an antioxidant.
classes.comment: N-Acetylcysteine is a non-standard amino acid used as an antioxidant for respiratory and kidney conditions.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Gabapentin is a NonStandardAminoAcid that is used as an anticonvulsant.
classes.comment: Gabapentin is a non-standard amino acid used as an anticonvulsant medication.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A NonStandardAminoAcid is an AminoAcid that is not one of the 20 standard proteinogenic amino acids, and can be used as drugs.
classes.comment: Non-standard amino acids are amino acids not typically found in proteins, some of which have medicinal uses.
